notes: v0.16.2 adds Apple Xcode 27/CoreDevice native wireless iPad readiness to the existing Asympta Computer plugin. Read-only ipad_wireless_status reports paired/disconnected/cable/network state with Mac Wi-Fi association advisory and cable-free Device Hub instructions. ipad_status, ipad_test and ipad_laser now accept wireless_only=true and refuse cable/unknown transport. Physical Wi-Fi success still requires the user to join a discoverable network, complete Trust/Pair Nearby Device prompts and remove USB before hardware verification. No new plugin/app or unofficial bypass.
